warnings: MOS device geometry overlaps the '55/0' voltage-domain marker: Dualgate (55/0) marks gf180mcu's 5V/6V thick-oxide voltage domain. This curated deck models it for the DF.1a/DF.3a COMP width/space rules only, which ship as _LV/_MV pairs (0.22/0.30 and 0.28/0.36 um) scoped to the marker; every other DRC rule still applies the 3.3V/_LV thresholds regardless of Dualgate's presence (e.g. DF.6 COMP extend beyond gate 0.24 vs. 0.40, PL.5a/PL.5b field poly to COMP 0.10 vs. 0.30 -- all in um, and neither transcribed in this deck yet), and MOS extraction always binds the 3.3V models (nfet_03v3/pfet_03v3) even to a transistor drawn entirely inside Dualgate.

1 layer (37/0) carrying 1 shape is outside 'gf180mcu' deck's connectivity graph -- this geometry is invisible to extraction, so a net routed only through it extracts as multiple disconnected nets instead of one, which will silently mismatch a downstream `klt lvs` reference netlist -- see ignored_layers[] for the full per-layer shape counts. See docs/cli/extract.md's 'ignored_layers' field documentation.
